outcomes.when: All semantic validation, catalog mapping, uniqueness checks, row construction, digest verification, writes, and marker commit succeed atomically.
outcomes.state_change: approval rows and marker are committed exactly once

outcomes.when: The same revision marker is already committed and the seed is byte-identical to the recorded revision.
outcomes.state_change: nothing changes; no row timestamp or generation is touched

outcomes.when: Seed revision, schema, fields, policy compatibility, structural values, or pre-commit digest construction or verification is invalid.
A seed source identity resolves to zero or more than one canonical CatalogEntry.entry_id.
Two seed rows collide on (model_id, decode_fingerprint), or existing approval state violates the migration uniqueness precondition.
outcomes.state_change: approvals and marker remain unchanged; no winner is selected

outcomes.when: Fencing, SQLite execution, durability, or commit fails after semantic input validation has succeeded.
outcomes.state_change: the transaction rolls back and approvals and marker remain unchanged

derived_approval_fields.approved_at_ms: the fenced migration transaction timestamp; required for enabled rows and never read from the seed
derived_approval_fields.updated_at_ms: the same transaction timestamp on first insert; excluded from semantic_digest

validation_order: reject unknown fields and forbidden runtime/evidence fields
resolve every source_catalog_entry_id to exactly one CatalogEntry.entry_id
verify the four expanded entries and the absence of the placeholder
check duplicate identities within the seed
check existing approval uniqueness before selecting any winner
construct rows and semantic_digest values in memory
verify every digest before opening the write phase
acquire store fence and compare the migration marker
write approvals and marker in one transaction
commit durability and render exactly one outcome

recovery_semantics.pre_commit_failure: rollback; rerun after correcting the seed; map digest failure to invalid_seed, never transaction_failed
recovery_semantics.post_validation_transaction_failure: rollback; preserve marker and approvals; inspect SQLite/fence/durability before retry
recovery_semantics.process_crash_before_commit: SQLite rollback leaves marker absent or previous; rerun produces applied
recovery_semantics.process_crash_after_commit: marker makes a retry already_applied and the retry is a no-op
recovery_semantics.different_seed_same_revision: invalid_seed; never reinterpret a committed revision
recovery_operator_procedure: record the exact rendered outcome and SQLite durability error if present
verify the marker and approval rows are unchanged on any non-success
repair fencing or storage infrastructure without editing approval rows
